response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical depth across multiple domains, extensive experience with developer tools (test runners, CI/CD, code generators), and clear leadership in open-source and workshop initiatives, but lacks explicit evidence of people management experience beyond technical mentorship and minimal mobile platform exposure, which are key for this role.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience building developer tools (test runners, CI/CD, code generators)
Proven track record in technical leadership via open-source projects and workshops
Broad technical stack including mobile (iOS/TV), build systems, and testing infrastructure
concerns: No clear documentation of formal people management or team leadership responsibilities
Limited evidence of mobile platform ecosystem experience beyond iOS app maintenance
No mention of strategic roadmap planning or organizational change leadership
